policy: Ratchet rule: entries may only be removed. Additions require an explicit compatibility review and a rationale tied to an upstream-internal implementation detail.

entries.rationale: Imports upstream's private decode/event-builder module and asserts its private event shape. Our public stream events intentionally add source-line metadata, and our value builder is exposed through the public package entry instead.

entries.case: reports line number when a parent key is missing its colon
entries.rationale: Asserts the upstream parser's exact diagnostic wording ('missing colon'); our public error reports the same line and source with different wording.

entries.case: reports a malformed array length marker with line and source
entries.rationale: Asserts the upstream parser's exact diagnostic wording ('invalid array length'); our public error preserves the line and source but calls this a malformed header length.

entries.case: attaches line context to errors raised during value parsing
entries.rationale: Asserts the upstream parser's exact unterminated-string wording; our public error attaches the same line and source under the 'invalid quoted string' diagnostic.

entries.case: reports blank lines inside an array with the line number of the blank
entries.rationale: Asserts the upstream scanner's internal blank-line cursor convention; our parser rejects the same malformed array while reporting the following material line.
